picks.editorial_note: A $38M ARPA-H award — the largest research grant in UVM's history — to build AI digital twins of critically ill patients is a landmark bet on AI-driven personalized medicine with life-saving stakes.
picks.title: Your AI Twin Could Save Your Life: UVM Awarded up to $38M…

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech and Amazon's new joint Science Hub formalizes a decade of collaboration into a sustained academic-industry research pipeline on autonomy and AI, a model other universities will watch closely.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Amazon Launch Joint Science Hub

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's open-source Tessera model mapping smallholder crops in Senegal with far less compute than existing methods shows real-world AI impact for food security in the developing world.
picks.title: AI tool for mapping smallholder crops proves itself in Senegal

picks.editorial_note: Brown engineers' brain-inspired imaging system that sees through fog by mimicking retinal responses is a genuine advance in neuromorphic sensing with clear defense, transport, and robotics applications.
picks.title: Brown University engineers build brain-inspired imaging system that can ‘see’ through fog

picks.editorial_note: UW-Madison's individualized AI 'brain roadmaps' linking cellular and genetic changes to Alzheimer's progression could meaningfully advance precision diagnosis and treatment for a disease with few reliable biomarkers.
picks.title: ‘We built a brain roadmap for each person’: New AI-driven tools help decode Alzheimer’s disease at the cellular level

picks.editorial_note: A $4.25M DARPA grant to a WashU-led team fusing AI with physics-based simulation for fuel injector design shows AI maturing as a core tool in defense-relevant engineering research.
picks.title: WashU-led team wins $4M DARPA grant to improve fuel injector design

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern's low-power implantable chip using machine learning to analyze brain signals in real time could enable earlier detection of neurological abnormalities, a notable step toward practical neurotech.
picks.title: This AI-powered chip can offer a deeper look at faulty brain activity

picks.editorial_note: Anthropic's rollout of text watermarking in Claude to comply with the EU AI Act is a concrete test case for how AI regulation is reshaping product design industry-wide.
picks.title: Will Claude's new AI "watermark" keep us all honest?

picks.editorial_note: UNSW students partnering with Commonwealth Bank to prototype fraud detection against a $2.18B annual problem demonstrates how academia-industry pipelines are tackling costly real-world problems with AI.
picks.title: The CBA partnership giving students the chance to solve a $2.18 billion problem

picks.editorial_note: University of Illinois professor Kaiyu Guan's MacArthur Fellowship recognizes his work building AI-integrated predictive agricultural science, underscoring the growing national recognition of AI applied to food systems.
picks.title: U. of I. researcher and alumnus both named 2026 MacArthur Fellows
